name: ecosystem-constellation
title: Ecosystem Constellation
description: A central product mark orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines. The eight satellites are generic placeholder marks, not real brands.
useWhen: The story is "we plug into everything": one hub product ringed by the tools it connects to.
The shot has to hold for a while: satellites assemble once on a staggered spring, then orbit and fire their lines one at a time.
avoidWhen: You need your own integration logos: edit the SVG marks in the file.
You want brand chips to arrive and hold with no orbit: use logo-enter.
author: Remocn
